response.sql:
WITH order_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    order_id,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as order_avg_quantity
  FROM Order_Items
  WHERE product_quantity IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY order_id
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_avg_quantity) as baseline_quantity
  FROM order_averages
)
SELECT 
  oa.order_id,
  oa.order_avg_quantity,
  oa.order_avg_quantity - b.baseline_quantity as difference
FROM order_averages oa
CROSS JOIN baseline b
WHERE b.baseline_quantity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN oa.order_avg_quantity - b.baseline_quantity IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  oa.order_avg_quantity - b.baseline_quantity DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: `product_quantity` is numeric data (possibly stored as VARCHAR) and can be cast to DECIMAL(19,4). The request to compute averages requires this to be treated as numeric.
"Ignoring missing values" means treating only SQL NULL as missing in aggregation. Empty strings are not treated as missing.

alternatives.interpretation: If empty strings should also be treated as missing (not just NULL), exclude them with `AND product_quantity != ''` in the WHERE clause of the CTE.
alternatives.sql:
WITH order_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    order_id,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as order_avg_quantity
  FROM Order_Items
  WHERE product_quantity IS NOT NULL AND product_quantity != ''
  GROUP BY order_id
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_avg_quantity) as baseline_quantity
  FROM order_averages
)
SELECT 
  oa.order_id,
  oa.order_avg_quantity,
  oa.order_avg_quantity - b.baseline_quantity as difference
FROM order_averages oa
CROSS JOIN baseline b
WHERE b.baseline_quantity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN oa.order_avg_quantity - b.baseline_quantity IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  oa.order_avg_quantity - b.baseline_quantity DESC
LIMIT 10;
